title: CORS/CSP/login (ngrok origin): config-driven allowed origins, preflight, credentials, headers on error responses

unapproved_origin_rejection.error_message: Cross-origin request blocked: origin not allowed by CORS policy.

root_cause_analysis.env_origins: cors.js only parsed process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS, ignoring process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN.
root_cause_analysis.csp_img_src: Content-Security-Policy img-src omitted blob:, which caused client preview renders of uploaded files and media to fail.
root_cause_analysis.csp_connect_src: Content-Security-Policy connect-src was restricted to 'self', blocking API and SSE calls when the dashboard is loaded via ngrok.
root_cause_analysis.error_handler: errorHandler in errors.js lacked an explicit guarantee of CORS headers for approved origins if unhandled exceptions occurred before response completion.
